name: openkrx
title_zh: 拆开匈牙利政府公文包 .krx，附件原样取出来
tagline_zh: 收到 Hivatali kapu 或 KÉR 发来的 .krx，双击只会报错、解压出来一堆乱码文件名。
tagline_en: A .krx from Hivatali kapu or KÉR won't open by double-clicking. openkrx lists the OCD container, validates.
desc_en: Inspect, list, structurally check, extract and create Hungarian KRX document packages (.krx, the ZIP-based OCD container used in Hungarian administrative correspondence) with the openkrx CLI. why_zh: 它认的是 OCD 容器规范而不是「当 zip 硬解」：先读元数据再动附件。
why_en: It reads the OCD container spec instead of brute-forcing the zip: metadata first, attachments second, and it errors out rather.
limit_zh: 只覆盖匈牙利 KRX/OCD 这一种公文包格式，别的国家或普通 zip 它不认；需要本机装好 openkrx CLI。
limit_en: Only Hungarian KRX/OCD packages, not other countries' formats or plain zips. Requires the openkrx CLI locally, no GUI. It checks structure and.
